package config

import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestEnumListDefaultRemainsLiteral(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultBuildOptions()
	require.NotNil(t, opt)
	assert.False(t, opt.Enabled)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{"home"}, opt.Locations, "enum defaults must not expand semantic keywords")
	require.NotNil(t, opt.LocationReferences)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{"home"}, *opt.LocationReferences)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{`quoted "home"\path`}, opt.Names, "constraint enum defaults must preserve escaped characters")
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{home}, opt.Directories, "non-enum defaults still expand semantic keywords")

	WithTracing()(opt)
	assert.True(t, opt.Enabled)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate(), "enabling the set must accept its declared enum default")
}
